accumulate.tip: 词根：ac(表加强)+cumul(堆积)+ate → 不断堆积 → 积累

accurate.en: correct in all details; exact and free from error
accurate.ex_en: The meteorological station provided an accurate weather forecast.
accurate.ex_cn: 气象站提供了准确的天气预报。
accurate.tip: 词根：ac(一再)+cur(关心、注意)+ate → 一再小心核对 → 准确的

acknowledge.en: to accept or admit the existence or truth of; to express gratitude for
acknowledge.ex_en: She refused to acknowledge that there was a flaw in the plan.
acknowledge.ex_cn: 她拒绝承认计划中存在缺陷。
acknowledge.tip: 助记：ac(去)+knowledge(知道) → 让大家都知道 → 承认；致谢

acquire.en: to buy or obtain an asset or object; to learn or develop a skill or habit
acquire.ex_en: Children acquire native language skills rapidly through daily interaction.
acquire.ex_cn: 儿童通过日常互动迅速习得母语技能。
acquire.tip: 词根：ac(加强)+quir(寻求)+e → 不断寻求并拿到 → 获得，习得

adapt.en: to become adjusted to new conditions; to modify for a new use or purpose
adapt.ex_en: Organisms must adapt to shifting environmental conditions to survive.
adapt.ex_cn: 生物必须适应不断变化的环境条件才能生存。
adapt.tip: 词根：ad(趋向)+apt(适当的) → 使变得适当 → 适应；改编（注意区分 adopt 收养/采纳）

adequate.en: satisfactory or acceptable in quality or quantity
adequate.ex_en: Make sure you get adequate sleep before the final examination.
adequate.ex_cn: 期末考试前务必保证充足的睡眠。
adequate.tip: 词根：ad(去)+equ(相等)+ate → 与需求相匹配的 → 充足的，适当的

advocate.en: to publicly recommend or support a particular policy or way of doing things
advocate.ex_en: Health experts advocate a balanced diet rich in vegetables and fiber.
advocate.ex_cn: 健康专家提倡富含蔬菜和纤维的均衡饮食。
advocate.tip: 词根：ad(加强)+voc(声音/喊叫)+ate → 大声疾呼支持 → 提倡，拥护

allocate.en: to distribute resources or duties for a particular purpose
allocate.ex_en: The committee decided to allocate more funds to basic scientific research.
allocate.ex_cn: 委员会决定向基础科学研究拨付更多资金。
allocate.tip: 词根：al(去)+loc(地方)+ate → 把资源放到指定位置 → 分配，拨给

alter.en: to change or cause to change in character or composition, typically in a comparatively small way
alter.ex_en: Nothing can alter the fact that we are responsible for our own choices.
alter.ex_cn: 没有什么能改变我们必须为自己选择负责这一事实。
alter.tip: 词根：alter(其他的) → 变成其他的样子 → 改变，改动

ambiguous.en: open to more than one interpretation; not having one obvious meaning
ambiguous.ex_en: The wording of the agreement is ambiguous and needs clarification.
ambiguous.ex_cn: 协议的措辞模棱两可，需要进一步澄清。
ambiguous.tip: 词根：ambi(两边)+ig(走)+uous → 往两边都能走 → 模棱两可的

anticipate.en: to regard as probable; to expect or predict and prepare for
anticipate.ex_en: We anticipate that demand for renewable energy will continue to rise.
anticipate.ex_cn: 我们预计对可再生能源的需求将继续上升。
anticipate.tip: 词根：anti(前)+cip(拿/抓)+ate → 提前把握趋势 → 预期，预料

apparent.en: clearly visible or understood; seeming real or true, but not necessarily so
apparent.ex_en: It soon became apparent that the project needed additional engineers.
apparent.ex_cn: 很快就能明显看出该项目需要更多工程师。
apparent.tip: 词根：ap(加强)+par(显现)+ent → 显现出来的 → 明显的；表面上的

assess.en: to evaluate or estimate the nature, ability, or quality of something
assess.ex_en: Standardized tests are one way to assess students' academic progress.
assess.ex_cn: 标准化测试是评估学生学业进步的一种方式。
assess.tip: 词根：as(旁边)+sess(坐) → 坐在旁边评审打分 → 评估，评定

attribute.en: to regard something as being caused by; a quality or feature regarded as a characteristic
attribute.ex_en: She attributes her recovery to regular exercise and a positive mindset.
attribute.ex_cn: 她把自己的康复归功于规律的运动和积极的心态。
attribute.tip: 词根：at(去)+tribut(给予)+e → 把原因归给某事 → 归因于；属性

authentic.en: of undisputed origin and not a copy; genuine and reliable
authentic.ex_en: The museum confirmed that the ancient manuscript is completely authentic.
authentic.ex_cn: 博物馆确认这份古代手稿完全是真品。
authentic.tip: 词根：auth(自己/作者)+entic → 出自原作者亲手之作 → 真品的，地道的

available.en: able to be used or obtained; at someone's disposal
available.ex_en: All dictionaries in Voca are available offline without internet access.
available.ex_cn: Voca中的所有词库均可在无网络环境下离线使用。
available.tip: 词根：a(加强)+vail(价值/效用)+able → 能发挥效用的 → 可用的

barrier.en: a fence or other obstacle that prevents movement or access
barrier.ex_en: Language should be a bridge for communication rather than a barrier.
barrier.ex_cn: 语言应当成为沟通的桥梁，而不是障碍。
barrier.tip: 词根：bar(横木/阻挡)+rier → 挡在面前的栅栏 → 障碍，壁垒

beneficial.en: resulting in good; favorable or advantageous
beneficial.ex_en: Spaced repetition is highly beneficial for long-term vocabulary retention.
beneficial.ex_cn: 间隔重复对词汇的长期记忆非常有益。
beneficial.tip: 词根：bene(好)+fic(做)+ial → 做出好事的 → 有益的，有利的

bias.en: inclination or prejudice for or against one person or group, especially in an unfair way
bias.ex_en: Researchers must design double-blind trials to eliminate observer bias.
bias.ex_cn: 研究人员必须设计双盲试验以消除观察者偏差。
bias.tip: 考研高频词：注意其学术含义“统计偏差、认知偏见”

capacity.en: the maximum amount that something can contain; the ability or power to do something
capacity.ex_en: The stadium has a seating capacity of sixty thousand spectators.
capacity.ex_cn: 这座体育场可容纳六万名观众。
capacity.tip: 词根：cap(抓、容纳)+acity → 能够容纳的量 → 容量；能力

catalyst.en: a substance that increases the rate of a chemical reaction; a person or thing that precipitates an event
catalyst.ex_en: Technological innovation acts as a catalyst for economic transformation.
catalyst.ex_cn: 技术创新是经济转型的催化剂。
catalyst.tip: 词根：cata(向下)+lyst(分解) → 加速化学分解之物 → 催化剂；促进因素

chronic.en: persisting for a long time or constantly recurring
chronic.ex_en: Lack of rest can lead to chronic fatigue and reduced concentration.
chronic.ex_cn: 缺乏休息会导致慢性疲劳和注意力下降。
chronic.tip: 词根：chron(时间)+ic → 持续很长时间的 → 慢性的，长期的

clarify.en: to make a statement or situation less confused and more clearly comprehensible
clarify.ex_en: Could you clarify the second point in your project proposal?
clarify.ex_cn: 你能阐明一下你项目提案中的第二点吗？
clarify.tip: 词根：clar(清楚)+ify(使…) → 使变得清楚 → 澄清，阐明

coherent.en: logical and consistent; united as or forming a whole
coherent.ex_en: The essay presents a coherent argument supported by empirical data.
coherent.ex_cn: 这篇论文提出了一个由实证数据支撑的条理清晰的论点。
coherent.tip: 词根：co(共同)+her(粘附)+ent → 紧密粘合在一起 → 连贯的，有条理的

coincide.en: to occur at or during the same time; to correspond in nature or in position
coincide.ex_en: His business trip happened to coincide with the international book fair.
coincide.ex_cn: 他的出差恰好与国际书展同时进行。
coincide.tip: 词根：co(共同)+in(进入)+cide(落下) → 落到同一个点上 → 同时发生；相符

collapse.en: to fall down or give way suddenly; a sudden failure of an institution or system
collapse.ex_en: Negotiations were on the verge of collapse before the new compromise.
collapse.ex_cn: 在达成新妥协之前，谈判曾濒临破裂。
collapse.tip: 词根：col(共同)+laps(滑落)+e → 全部滑落下来 → 倒塌，崩溃

colleague.en: a person with whom one works in a profession or business
colleague.ex_en: She discussed the new software architecture with her senior colleagues.
colleague.ex_cn: 她与资深同事们讨论了新的软件架构。
colleague.tip: 词根：col(共同)+leag(选择/选派)+ue → 被选派到一起工作的人 → 同事

compensate.en: to give someone something, typically money, in recognition of loss, suffering, or injury
compensate.ex_en: Hard work and systematic methods can compensate for a lack of experience.
compensate.ex_cn: 努力工作和系统的方法可以弥补经验的不足。
compensate.tip: 词根：com(全部)+pens(称重/花费)+ate → 把失去的分量补齐 → 补偿，弥补

compile.en: to produce a list or book by assembling information collected from other sources; to convert source code into machine code
compile.ex_en: It took the lexicographers five years to compile this bilingual dictionary.
compile.ex_cn: 词典编纂者花了五年时间才编成这部双语词典。
compile.tip: 词根：com(一起)+pil(堆积)+e → 搜集堆放到一起 → 汇编；编译

complement.en: a thing that contributes extra features to something else in such a way as to improve or emphasize its quality
complement.ex_en: Listening dictation and spelling tests complement each other in word learning.
complement.ex_cn: 在单词学习中，听写训练和拼写测试相辅相成。
complement.tip: 注意区分：complement（补充，e=complete完善）vs compliment（赞美，i=我夸你）

comprehensive.en: including or dealing with all or nearly all elements or aspects of something
comprehensive.ex_en: We conducted a comprehensive review of the existing software architecture.
comprehensive.ex_cn: 我们对现有软件架构进行了全面深入的审查。
comprehensive.tip: 词根：com(全部)+prehens(抓住)+ive → 把所有方面都抓在手里 → 全面的，综合的

compromise.en: an agreement reached by each side making concessions; to weaken or harm by accepting standards that are lower than desirable
compromise.ex_en: We must never compromise data reliability for the sake of rapid delivery.
compromise.ex_cn: 我们绝不能为了快速交付而牺牲数据的可靠性。
compromise.tip: 考研熟词僻义：除“妥协”外，考研常考动词义“危及、损害（名誉/安全/原则）”

conceive.en: to form or devise a plan or idea in the mind
conceive.ex_en: It is difficult to conceive of modern life without portable computing devices.
conceive.ex_cn: 很难设想没有便携式计算设备的现代生活会是什么样。
conceive.tip: 词根：con(共同)+ceiv(拿、抓) → 在脑海里抓取形成概念 → 构想，设想

concentrate.en: to focus all one's attention on a particular object or activity
concentrate.ex_en: A clean interface helps learners concentrate on memorizing vocabulary.
concentrate.ex_cn: 简洁的界面有助于学习者集中精力记忆词汇。
concentrate.tip: 词根：con(共同)+centr(中心)+ate → 聚拢到同一个中心 → 集中，专注

confer.en: to grant a title, degree, benefit, or right; to have discussions or exchange opinions
confer.ex_en: The university will confer honorary degrees on three distinguished scientists.
confer.ex_cn: 该大学将向三位杰出科学家授予荣誉学位。
confer.tip: 词根：con(共同)+fer(带来) → 把意见拿到一起（商讨）；把荣誉带给某人（授予）

confident.en: feeling or showing certainty about something; self-assured
confident.ex_en: Consistent daily review makes students feel confident in the examination hall.
confident.ex_cn: 坚持每日复习能让学生在考场上充满自信。
confident.tip: 词根：con(完全)+fid(相信)+ent → 完全相信自己的 → 自信的

confine.en: to keep or restrict someone or something within certain limits of space, scope, or time
confine.ex_en: Please confine your remarks to the specific topic under discussion.
confine.ex_cn: 请将你的发言限制在当前讨论的具体议题范围内。
confine.tip: 词根：con(共同)+fin(边界)+e → 圈在边界之内 → 限制，局限于

confirm.en: to establish the truth or correctness of something previously believed or suspected
confirm.ex_en: Experiments confirm that active recall is far more effective than passive reading.
confirm.ex_cn: 实验证实，主动回忆远比被动阅读有效得多。
confirm.tip: 词根：con(完全)+firm(坚定) → 使完全确定 → 确认，证实

conflict.en: a serious disagreement or argument; to be incompatible or at variance
conflict.ex_en: When sources conflict, always verify against the most recent primary evidence.
conflict.ex_cn: 当信息来源发生冲突时，务必以最新的一手证据为准进行核实。
conflict.tip: 词根：con(共同)+flict(打击) → 互相撞击 → 冲突，抵触

conform.en: to comply with rules, standards, or laws; to behave according to socially acceptable conventions
conform.ex_en: All exported packages must conform to the platform's binary specifications.
conform.ex_cn: 所有导出的安装包都必须符合平台的二进制规范。
conform.tip: 词根：con(共同)+form(形状/形式) → 保持同样的形式 → 遵守，顺应

confront.en: to come face to face with someone with hostile or argumentative intent; to deal with a difficult situation
confront.ex_en: We must confront technical challenges directly rather than avoiding them.
confront.ex_cn: 我们必须直面技术挑战，而不是回避它们。
confront.tip: 词根：con(共同)+front(前额/正面) → 正面迎上去 → 面临，直面

consensus.en: a general agreement among a group of people
consensus.ex_en: After a thorough discussion, the engineering team reached a consensus on the design.
consensus.ex_cn: 经过充分讨论，工程团队就设计方案达成了共识。
consensus.tip: 词根：con(共同)+sens(感觉/看法)+us → 大家看法一致 → 共识

consequence.en: a result or effect of an action or condition; importance or relevance
consequence.ex_en: Understanding the long-term consequences of design choices is essential.
consequence.ex_cn: 理解设计决策的长远后果至关重要。
consequence.tip: 考研熟词僻义：of no consequence 意为“无关紧要、无足轻重”

conserve.en: to protect something environmentally or culturally important from harm or destruction
conserve.ex_en: Dark mode on OLED screens helps conserve battery power on mobile devices.
conserve.ex_cn: OLED屏幕上的纯黑模式有助于节省移动设备的电池电量。
conserve.tip: 词根：con(全部)+serv(保持)+e → 完整地保存下来 → 保护，节约

consistent.en: acting or done in the same way over time; compatible or in agreement
consistent.ex_en: Both platforms must maintain a consistent core learning workflow.
consistent.ex_cn: 两个平台必须保持一致的核心学习流程。
consistent.tip: 词根：con(共同)+sist(站立)+ent → 始终站在同一立场上 → 始终如一的，一致的

conspicuous.en: standing out so as to be clearly visible; attracting notice or attention
conspicuous.ex_en: Errors in spelling were conspicuous on the printed summary sheet.
conspicuous.ex_cn: 打印出来的汇总表上，拼写错误格外显眼。
conspicuous.tip: 词根：con(加强)+spic(看)+uous → 一眼就能看到的 → 显眼的，引人注目的

constant.en: occurring continuously over a period of time; remaining the same
constant.ex_en: Offline software does not require a constant network connection to function.
constant.ex_cn: 离线软件不需要持续不断的网络连接即可正常运行。
constant.tip: 词根：con(加强)+stant(站立) → 站在那里纹丝不动 → 恒定的，持续的

constitute.en: to be a part of a whole; to combine to form something
constitute.ex_en: Twelve months constitute a calendar year.
constitute.ex_cn: 十二个月构成一个日历年。
constitute.tip: 词根：con(共同)+stitut(建立/放置)+e → 放在一起建立起来 → 构成，组成

constrain.en: to severely restrict the scope, extent, or activity of; to compel or force
constrain.ex_en: Hardware memory limits may constrain the size of in-memory caches.
constrain.ex_cn: 硬件内存上限可能会限制内存缓存的大小。
constrain.tip: 词根：con(共同)+strain(拉紧) → 把绳子拉紧捆住 → 限制，约束

consume.en: to use up a resource; to eat, drink, or ingest; to completely fill the mind of
consume.ex_en: Lightweight native applications consume far less memory than heavy frameworks.
consume.ex_cn: 轻量级原生应用程序比臃肿的框架消耗少得多的内存。
consume.tip: 词根：con(全部)+sum(拿)+e → 全部拿光用掉 → 消耗，耗费

contemporary.en: living or occurring at the same time; belonging to or occurring in the present
contemporary.ex_en: Voca blends contemporary minimalist typography with proven memory science.
contemporary.ex_cn: Voca将当代极简主义排版与经过验证的记忆科学融为一体。
contemporary.tip: 词根：con(共同)+tempor(时间)+ary → 处于同一时代的 → 同时代的；当代的

contend.en: to assert something as a position in an argument; to struggle to surmount a difficulty
contend.ex_en: Some linguists contend that context is the single best aid for vocabulary acquisition.
contend.ex_cn: 一些语言学家主张，语境是词汇习得最好的辅助手段。
contend.tip: 考研高频词：contend that...（主张/认为…）；contend with...（对付/抗衡…）

context.en: the circumstances that form the setting for an event, statement, or idea
context.ex_en: Guessing a word's meaning from context strengthens deep semantic memory.
context.ex_cn: 根据上下文猜测词义能够强化深层语义记忆。
context.tip: 词根：con(共同)+text(编织) → 编织在一起的前后文 → 语境，背景

contradict.en: to deny the truth of a statement by asserting the opposite; to be in conflict with
contradict.ex_en: The witness's second statement did not contradict the physical evidence.
contradict.ex_cn: 证人的第二份陈述与物证并不矛盾。
contradict.tip: 词根：contra(反)+dict(说) → 反着说 → 反驳，相矛盾

contribute.en: to give something in order to help achieve or provide something; to help to cause
contribute.ex_en: Daily phonetic practice will contribute significantly to your listening comprehension.
contribute.ex_cn: 每日的音标与发音练习将极大地促进你的听力理解能力。
contribute.tip: 词根：con(共同)+tribut(给予)+e → 大家一起出钱出力 → 贡献，有助于

controversy.en: prolonged public disagreement or heated discussion
controversy.ex_en: The new policy sparked a heated controversy among education specialists.
controversy.ex_cn: 这项新政策在教育专家中引发了激烈的争议。
controversy.tip: 词根：contro(反)+vers(转)+y → 观点反着转 → 争议，论战

convene.en: to come or bring together for a meeting or activity; to assemble
convene.ex_en: The committee will convene next Monday to finalize the syllabus update.
convene.ex_cn: 委员会将于下周一开会，敲定大纲更新内容。
convene.tip: 词根：con(共同)+ven(来)+e → 大家来到一起 → 召集，开会

converge.en: to tend to meet at a point; to approach an intersection or common state
converge.ex_en: Desktop and mobile user experiences converge around a unified learning engine.
converge.ex_cn: 桌面端和移动端的用户体验围绕统一的学习引擎交汇融合。
converge.tip: 词根：con(共同)+verg(倾斜/转向)+e → 朝同一个点汇拢 → 汇集，收敛（反义：diverge 分歧）

convey.en: to make an idea, impression, or feeling known or understandable to someone; to transport
convey.ex_en: Colors and typography help convey a calm, focused atmosphere.
convey.ex_cn: 色彩和排版有助于传递一种平静、专注的氛围。
convey.tip: 词根：con(共同)+vey(道路/走) → 通过道路送过去 → 运送；传递（思想）

convince.en: to cause someone to believe firmly in the truth of something; to persuade
convince.ex_en: Empirical test results convinced the team to adopt the offline SQLite architecture.
convince.ex_cn: 实证测试结果使团队信服并采用了离线SQLite架构。
convince.tip: 词根：con(彻底)+vinc(征服)+e → 彻底以理服人 → 使信服，说服

cooperate.en: to work jointly toward the same end; to assist someone or comply with their requests
cooperate.ex_en: Hardware and software layers cooperate seamlessly to reduce latency.
cooperate.ex_cn: 硬件层与软件层无缝协作以降低延迟。
cooperate.tip: 词根：co(共同)+oper(工作)+ate → 一起工作 → 合作，协作

coordinate.en: to bring the different elements of a complex activity or organization into a harmonious relationship
coordinate.ex_en: The scheduler coordinates new word learning with five Ebbinghaus review stages.
coordinate.ex_cn: 调度器将新词学习与五个艾宾浩斯复习阶段统筹协调起来。
coordinate.tip: 词根：co(共同)+ordin(秩序/排列)+ate → 排成共同的秩序 → 协调；坐标

correspond.en: to have a close similarity; to match or agree almost exactly; to communicate by exchanging letters
correspond.ex_en: The test conclusions must correspond strictly to actual verification results.
correspond.ex_cn: 测试结论必须与实际验证结果严格一致。
correspond.tip: 词根：cor(共同)+respond(回应) → 彼此呼应 → 相符，一致；通信

criteria.en: principles or standards by which something may be judged or decided
criteria.ex_en: Data integrity and offline availability are our primary evaluation criteria.
criteria.ex_cn: 数据完整性与离线可用性是我们的首要评估准则。
criteria.tip: 词根：crit(判断)+eria → 用于衡量判断的依据 → 准则，标准（注意其为复数形式）

crucial.en: decisive or critical, especially in the success or failure of something
crucial.ex_en: Timely review within 24 hours is crucial for consolidating short-term memory.
crucial.ex_cn: 24小时内的及时复习对于巩固短期记忆至关重要。
crucial.tip: 词根：cruc(十字路口)+ial → 处在人生十字路口的 → 关键的，决定性的

cultivate.en: to try to acquire or develop a quality, sentiment, or skill; to prepare and use land for crops
cultivate.ex_en: Reading English definitions helps cultivate an authentic sense of the language.
cultivate.ex_cn: 阅读英文释义有助于培养地道的语感。
cultivate.tip: 词根：cult(耕种/培养)+iv+ate → 像耕耘土地一样培育心智 → 培养，耕作

cumulative.en: increasing or increased in quantity, degree, or force by successive additions
cumulative.ex_en: The cumulative effect of learning thirty words a day is ten thousand words a year.
cumulative.ex_cn: 每天学三十个单词的累积效应是一年掌握一万词。
cumulative.tip: 词根：cumul(堆积)+ative → 越堆越多的 → 累积的

curb.en: to restrain or keep in check; a check or restraint on something
curb.ex_en: Structured review schedules help curb the natural rate of forgetting.
curb.ex_cn: 结构化的复习计划有助于遏制自然的遗忘速度。
curb.tip: 考研高频词：原指勒马的嚼子，引申为“抑制、控制、遏制”

decline.en: to become smaller, fewer, or less; to politely refuse an invitation or offer
decline.ex_en: Without periodic reinforcement, memory retention will inevitably decline.
decline.ex_cn: 如果没有周期性的强化，记忆留存率不可避免地会下降。
decline.tip: 词根：de(向下)+clin(倾斜)+e → 向下倾斜 → 下降，衰退；婉拒

dedicate.en: to devote time, effort, or oneself to a particular task or purpose
dedicate.ex_en: She decided to dedicate thirty minutes every morning to vocabulary review.
dedicate.ex_cn: 她决定每天早晨专门花三十分钟复习词汇。
dedicate.tip: 词根：de(加强)+dic(说/宣告)+ate → 庄重宣告将一生献给事业 → 致力于，奉献

deduce.en: to arrive at a fact or a conclusion by reasoning; to draw as a logical conclusion
deduce.ex_en: From the root and prefix, you can often deduce the general meaning of an unfamiliar word.
deduce.ex_cn: 从词根和前缀中，你通常可以推断出陌生单词的大致含义。
deduce.tip: 词根：de(向下)+duc(引导)+e → 顺着逻辑向下推导 → 演绎，推断

deficiency.en: a lack or shortage; a failing or shortcoming
deficiency.ex_en: Vocabulary deficiency is often the primary bottleneck in reading comprehension.
deficiency.ex_cn: 词汇量匮乏往往是阅读理解中的首要瓶颈。
deficiency.tip: 词根：de(向下/不够)+fic(做)+iency → 做得不够 → 缺乏，不足

deliberate.en: done consciously and intentionally; careful and unhurried
deliberate.ex_en: Deliberate practice focuses specifically on the words you frequently miss.
deliberate.ex_cn: 刻意练习专门针对你经常记错的那些重难点词汇。
deliberate.tip: 考研高频熟词：作形容词为“故意的；深思熟虑的”，作动词为“仔细商讨”

demonstrate.en: to clearly show the existence or truth of something by giving proof or evidence
demonstrate.ex_en: Ebbinghaus's classic experiments demonstrate how rapidly initial forgetting occurs.
demonstrate.ex_cn: 艾宾浩斯的经典实验证明了最初阶段的遗忘发生得有多快。
demonstrate.tip: 词根：de(加强)+monstr(展示)+ate → 清楚地展示出来 → 证明，演示

denote.en: to be a sign of; to indicate; to stand as a name or symbol for
denote.ex_en: In phonetic transcriptions, the stress mark denotes which syllable receives primary emphasis.
denote.ex_cn: 在音标中，重音符号表示哪个音节需要重读。
denote.tip: 词根：de(加强)+not(标记)+e → 用记号标明 → 表示，意味着

depict.en: to show or represent by a drawing, painting, or other art form; to portray in words
depict.ex_en: The progress chart clearly depicts your daily vocabulary growth curve.
depict.ex_cn: 进度图表清晰地描绘出你每日的词汇增长曲线。
depict.tip: 词根：de(加强)+pict(画) → 生动地画出来 → 描绘，描述

deplete.en: to use up the supply or resources of; to diminish in number or quantity
deplete.ex_en: Studying for five hours without a break will quickly deplete your mental energy.
deplete.ex_cn: 连续学习五小时不休息会迅速耗尽你的脑力精力。
deplete.tip: 词根：de(去掉)+plet(满)+e → 从满的状态抽空 → 耗尽，用尽

derive.en: to obtain something from a specified source; to base a concept on a logical extension
derive.ex_en: Many English academic words derive from Latin and classical Greek roots.
derive.ex_cn: 许多英语学术词汇源于拉丁语和古典希腊语词根。
derive.tip: 词根：de(向下)+riv(河流)+e → 顺着源流往下流淌 → 源于，导出

detect.en: to discover or identify the presence or existence of something
detect.ex_en: The import module automatically detects UTF-8 and GBK file encodings.
detect.ex_cn: 导入模块会自动检测 UTF-8 和 GBK 文件编码。
detect.tip: 词根：de(去掉)+tect(盖子) → 揭开盖子发现真相 → 探测，察觉

deteriorate.ex_en: Language proficiency can deteriorate rapidly if you stop reading and practicing.
deteriorate.ex_cn: 如果停止阅读和练习，语言能力可能会迅速退化。
deteriorate.tip: 词根：deterior(更坏)+ate → 变得越来越糟 → 恶化，退化

determine.en: to cause something to occur in a particular way; to ascertain or establish exactly
determine.ex_en: Your daily consistency will determine how quickly you master the entire lexicon.
determine.ex_cn: 你每天的坚持将决定你多快能掌握整个词库。
determine.tip: 词根：de(加强)+termin(界限)+e → 划定明确的界限 → 确定，决定

deviate.en: to depart from an established course or standard
deviate.ex_en: Do not deviate from your Ebbinghaus review plan during the critical first week.
deviate.ex_cn: 在关键的第一周内，不要偏离你的艾宾浩斯复习计划。
deviate.tip: 词根：de(偏离)+vi(道路)+ate → 走离正轨 → 偏离，背离

devise.en: to plan or invent a complex procedure, system, or mechanism by careful thought
devise.ex_en: Hermann Ebbinghaus devised a scientific method to measure memory decay.
devise.ex_cn: 赫尔曼·艾宾浩斯设计了一种测量记忆衰退的科学方法。
devise.tip: 助记：与名牌设备 device 同源，作动词意为“精心设计、想出”

differentiate.en: to recognize or ascertain what makes someone or something different
differentiate.ex_en: Good learners differentiate between active writing vocabulary and passive reading words.
differentiate.ex_cn: 优秀的学习者会区分主动写作词汇与被动阅读词汇。
differentiate.tip: 词根：different(不同的)+iate → 分辨出不同之处 → 区分，区别

diffuse.en: to spread or cause to spread over a wide area or among a large number of people
diffuse.ex_en: Printed books helped diffuse scientific knowledge across continents.
diffuse.ex_cn: 印刷书籍帮助科学知识跨越大陆广泛传播。
diffuse.tip: 词根：dif(分开)+fus(流/倾倒)+e → 四散流开 → 扩散，传播

dilemma.en: a situation in which a difficult choice has to be made between two or more alternatives
dilemma.ex_en: Engineers often face a dilemma between feature richness and interface simplicity.
dilemma.ex_cn: 工程师经常在功能丰富度与界面简洁性之间面临两难抉择。
dilemma.tip: 词根：di(二)+lemma(前提/争论) → 两个前提都难选 → 进退两难

diminish.en: to make or become less; to cause to seem less impressive or valuable
diminish.ex_en: As you move mastered words out of the list, your review workload will steadily diminish.
diminish.ex_cn: 随着你将熟词移出列表，你的复习负担会稳步减轻。
diminish.tip: 词根：di(加强)+min(小)+ish → 使变得越来越小 → 减少，削弱

discern.en: to perceive or recognize something; to distinguish someone or something with difficulty
discern.ex_en: With practice, you can discern subtle differences in usage between near-synonyms.
discern.ex_cn: 通过练习，你可以辨别近义词之间在用法上的微妙差异。
discern.tip: 词根：dis(分开)+cern(筛分/搞清) → 把混在一起的东西分辨清 → 明辨，察觉

discrepancy.en: a lack of compatibility or similarity between two or more facts
discrepancy.ex_en: The audit revealed a discrepancy between the expected and actual record counts.
discrepancy.ex_cn: 审查发现预期记录数与实际记录数之间存在出入。
discrepancy.tip: 词根：dis(不一致)+crep(发出杂音)+ancy → 声音不和谐 → 差异，矛盾

discrete.ex_en: Breaking a massive lexicon into fifteen discrete lists makes learning manageable.
discrete.ex_cn: 将庞大的词库拆分为十五个独立的词表能让学习变得易于管理。
discrete.tip: 注意区分：discrete（离散的，e被t分开）vs discreet（言行谨慎的，ee紧挨在一起）

discriminate.en: to recognize a distinction; to make an unjust or prejudicial distinction
discriminate.ex_en: Phonetic training helps your ear discriminate between similar vowel sounds.
discriminate.ex_cn: 语音训练有助于你的耳朵辨别相似的元音发音。
discriminate.tip: 词根：dis(分开)+crimin(分辨/审理)+ate → 区分开来；区别对待

displace.en: to take over the place, position, or role of someone or something
displace.ex_en: Digital flashcard systems have largely displaced bulky paper index cards.
displace.ex_cn: 数字化单词卡系统在很大程度上取代了笨重的纸质索引卡片。
displace.tip: 词根：dis(移开)+place(位置) → 移走原物占其位置 → 取代，置换

dispose.en: to get rid of by throwing away or giving or selling to someone else; to incline someone toward
dispose.ex_en: Once a word is permanently memorized, you can dispose of it from your active queue.
dispose.ex_cn: 一旦某个单词被永久记住，你就可以将其从当前学习队列中移除。
dispose.tip: 词根：dis(分开)+pos(放置)+e → 分别安排妥当 → 处置，倾向于

disrupt.en: to interrupt an event, activity, or process by causing a disturbance or problem
disrupt.ex_en: Pop-up advertisements disrupt concentration, which is why Voca is completely ad-free.
disrupt.ex_cn: 弹窗广告会打乱注意力，因此 Voca 完全不含任何广告。
disrupt.tip: 词根：dis(四散)+rupt(断裂) → 使原本连续的过程断开 → 扰乱，中断

dissipate.en: to disappear or cause to disappear; to squander or fritter away
dissipate.ex_en: Initial exam anxiety quickly dissipates once you follow a clear daily study plan.
dissipate.ex_cn: 一旦你遵循清晰的每日学习计划，最初的考试焦虑很快就会消散。
dissipate.tip: 词根：dis(四散)+sip(投掷)+ate → 四处挥洒殆尽 → 消散；挥霍

distinct.en: recognizably different in nature from something else of a similar type; readily perceived
distinct.ex_en: Voca offers four distinct visual themes tailored for daytime and nighttime reading.
distinct.ex_cn: Voca 提供四种截然不同的视觉主题，专为日间和夜间阅读量身定制。
distinct.tip: 词根：di(分开)+stinct(刺/标志) → 做好不同标记区分开的 → 截然不同的，清晰的

distort.en: to pull or twist out of shape; to give a misleading or false account of
distort.ex_en: Never distort or fabricate test results when evaluating software stability.
distort.ex_cn: 评估软件稳定性时，绝不能歪曲或伪造测试结果。
distort.tip: 词根：dis(偏离)+tort(扭曲) → 拧歪了 → 扭曲，歪曲

distribute.en: to give shares of something; to deal out; to spread throughout a space or area
distribute.ex_en: In shuffle mode, the algorithm distributes high-frequency words evenly across all lists.
distribute.ex_cn: 在乱序模式下，算法将高频词均匀分配到各个词表中。
distribute.tip: 词根：dis(分开)+tribut(给予)+e → 分发给每个人 → 分配，分布

diverse.en: showing a great deal of variety; very different
diverse.ex_en: Our learners have diverse goals ranging from graduate entrance exams to academic reading.
diverse.ex_cn: 我们的学习者有着从考研到学术阅读等多种多样的学习目标。
diverse.tip: 词根：di(分开)+vers(转)+e → 朝不同方向转 → 多样的，不同的

divert.en: to cause someone or something to change course or turn from one direction to another
divert.ex_en: Minimalist design ensures that decorative elements never divert your attention from the word.
divert.ex_cn: 极简设计确保装饰元素绝不会分散你对单词本身的注意力。
divert.tip: 词根：di(偏离)+vert(转) → 转到别的路上 → 使转向，转移注意力

dominant.ex_en: Spaced repetition remains the dominant paradigm in evidence-based memory software.
dominant.ex_cn: 间隔重复仍然是循证记忆软件中占主导地位的范式。
dominant.tip: 词根：domin(统治/主人)+ant → 处于统治地位的 → 占主导地位的

drastic.en: likely to have a strong or far-reaching effect; radical and extreme
drastic.ex_en: Removing mastered words brings a drastic reduction in daily review time.
drastic.ex_cn: 剔除已掌握的熟词能大幅缩减每日的复习耗时。
drastic.tip: 助记：drast(做/行动)+ic → 采取雷厉风行行动的 → 大刀阔斧的，猛烈的

durable.en: able to withstand wear, pressure, or damage; hard-wearing and long-lasting
durable.ex_en: Combining visual cards, audio dictation, and active spelling creates durable memory traces.
durable.ex_cn: 将视觉卡片、听写和主动拼写相结合能形成持久的记忆痕迹。
durable.tip: 词根：dur(持续/坚硬)+able → 能够长久持续的 → 耐用的，持久的

dynamic.en: characterized by constant change, activity, or progress; energetic
dynamic.ex_en: The dynamic schedule adjusts automatically whenever you reset or customize your list count.
dynamic.ex_cn: 每当你重置或自定义 List 数量时，动态计划表都会自动调整。
dynamic.tip: 词根：dynam(力量/动力)+ic → 有内在驱动力的 → 动态的，充满活力的

elaborate.en: involving many carefully arranged parts or details; to develop or present in detail
elaborate.ex_en: Tap the dictionary button to elaborate on a word's etymology and collocations.
elaborate.ex_cn: 点击词典按钮可详细展开单词的词源与搭配用法。
elaborate.tip: 词根：e(出)+labor(劳动)+ate → 花费大量心血做出来的 → 精巧详尽的；详细阐述

elevate.en: to raise or lift something to a higher position; to raise to a more important or impressive level
elevate.ex_en: Mastering core academic vocabulary will noticeably elevate your writing score.
elevate.ex_cn: 掌握核心学术词汇将显著提高你的写作得分。
elevate.tip: 词根：e(出)+lev(轻/举起)+ate → 向上举起 → 提升，提高

elicit.en: to evoke or draw out a reaction, answer, or fact from someone
elicit.ex_en: Hiding the Chinese translation is designed to elicit active recall from your memory.
elicit.ex_cn: 隐藏中文释义旨在诱发你大脑的主动回忆。
elicit.tip: 注意区分：elicit（引出、诱出，动词）vs illicit（非法的，形容词）

eliminate.en: to completely remove or get rid of something
eliminate.ex_en: Swipe left on any word you already know well to eliminate it from future study rounds.
eliminate.ex_cn: 对任何你已经烂熟于心的单词向左滑动，即可将其从后续学习轮次中剔除。
eliminate.tip: 词根：e(出)+limin(门槛)+ate → 赶出门槛之外 → 淘汰，消除

elusive.en: difficult to find, catch, or achieve; difficult to remember or recall
elusive.ex_en: The exact nuance of an elusive word becomes clear when seen in a vivid sentence.
elusive.ex_cn: 一个难以捉摸的词汇的微妙含义，在生动的例句中会变得清晰明了。
elusive.tip: 词根：e(出)+lus(玩耍/溜走)+ive → 泥鳅一样溜走的 → 难以捉摸的，易忘的

emancipate.en: to set free, especially from legal, social, or political restrictions
emancipate.ex_en: Offline capability emancipates learners from reliance on unstable network connections.
emancipate.ex_cn: 离线能力将学习者从对不稳定网络连接的依赖中解放出来。
emancipate.tip: 词根：e(出)+man(手)+cip(抓)+ate → 从紧抓的手中放出来 → 解放

embody.en: to be an expression of or give a tangible or visible form to an idea, quality, or feeling
embody.ex_en: Voca's interface is crafted to embody clarity, focus, and effortless efficiency.
embody.ex_cn: Voca的界面设计旨在体现清晰、专注与流畅高效。
embody.tip: 词根：em(使…)+body(身体/实体) → 赋予具体形体 → 体现，包含

embrace.en: to hold closely in one's arms; to accept or support willingly and enthusiastically
embrace.ex_en: Successful learners embrace mistakes during spelling tests as opportunities to strengthen memory.
embrace.ex_cn: 成功的学习者欣然接受拼写测试中的错误，将其视为强化记忆的契机。
embrace.tip: 词根：em(进入)+brace(双臂) → 揽入双臂之中 → 拥抱；欣然接受

emerge.en: to move out of or away from something and come into view; to become apparent
emerge.ex_en: Clear patterns of progress emerge after just seven days of Ebbinghaus review.
emerge.ex_cn: 仅仅经过七天的艾宾浩斯复习，清晰的进步轨迹就会显现出来。
emerge.tip: 词根：e(出)+merg(沉没)+e → 从水中浮出水面 → 浮现，出现

empirical.en: based on, concerned with, or verifiable by observation or experience rather than theory or pure logic
empirical.ex_en: Every conclusion in our technical report is grounded in empirical verification.
empirical.ex_cn: 我们技术报告中的每一项结论都建立在实证验证的基础之上。
empirical.tip: 考研核心学术词：常与 theoretical（理论上的）对比出现，意为“实证的、实验验证的”

emulate.en: to match or surpass a person or achievement, typically by imitation
emulate.ex_en: While drawing inspiration from classic apps, Voca does not merely emulate them.
emulate.ex_cn: 在汲取经典应用灵感的同时，Voca 并非简单地模仿它们。
emulate.tip: 词根：emul(竞争/赶超)+ate → 在学习借鉴中力求超越 → 效仿，仿真

encompass.en: to surround and have or hold within; to include comprehensively
encompass.ex_en: The built-in lexicons encompass CET-4, CET-6, Postgraduate, and Academic English.
encompass.ex_cn: 内置词库涵盖了四级、六级、考研和学术英语词汇。
encompass.tip: 词根：en(进入)+compass(罗盘/范围) → 纳入罗盘范围之内 → 包含，涵盖

endeavor.en: to try hard to do or achieve something; an attempt to achieve a goal
endeavor.ex_en: Mastering a foreign language is a rewarding lifelong endeavor.
endeavor.ex_cn: 掌握一门外语是一项回报丰厚的终身事业。
endeavor.tip: 助记：en(使)+deavor(职责) → 尽心尽力履行职责 → 努力，事业

endow.en: to provide with a quality, ability, or asset; to give or bequeath an income or property to
endow.ex_en: Human beings are endowed with a remarkable capacity for associative memory.
endow.ex_cn: 人类天生具备非凡的联想记忆能力。
endow.tip: 常考搭配：be endowed with...（天生具有…，被赋予…）

endure.en: to suffer something painful or difficult patiently; to remain in existence; to last
endure.ex_en: Knowledge acquired through spaced active recall will endure for years.
endure.ex_cn: 通过间隔主动回忆获得的知识将持久保留多年。
endure.tip: 词根：en(使)+dur(持久/坚硬)+e → 经受住考验持续下去 → 忍耐；持久

enhance.en: to intensify, increase, or further improve the quality, value, or extent of
enhance.ex_en: Bilingual example sentences and audio pronunciation greatly enhance memory retention.
enhance.ex_cn: 双语例句与语音朗读极大地增强了记忆留存率。
enhance.tip: 词根：en(使)+hanc(高)+e → 使推向更高水平 → 提高，增强

enlightenment.en: the action of enlightening or the state of being enlightened; spiritual or intellectual awakening
enlightenment.ex_en: Reading philosophical classics brings intellectual enlightenment and critical perspective.
enlightenment.ex_cn: 阅读哲学经典能带来智识上的启迪与批判性视角。
enlightenment.tip: 词根：en(使)+light(光)+en+ment → 照亮心灵驱散蒙昧 → 启迪，启蒙

entail.en: to involve something as a necessary or inevitable part or consequence
entail.ex_en: Building reliable dual-platform software entails rigorous testing and data validation.
entail.ex_cn: 开发可靠的双平台软件需要严格的测试与数据验证。
entail.tip: 考研高频词：A entails B 意为“A必然伴随/需要B”

entity.en: a thing with distinct and independent existence
entity.ex_en: In database design, each vocabulary word is modeled as an independent entity.
entity.ex_cn: 在数据库设计中，每个词汇都被建模为一个独立的实体。
entity.tip: 词根：ent(存在)+ity → 客观实在之物 → 实体

enumerate.en: to mention a number of things one by one
enumerate.ex_en: The documentation enumerates all supported import file formats and keyboard shortcuts.
enumerate.ex_cn: 文档逐一列举了所有受支持的导入文件格式和键盘快捷键。
enumerate.tip: 词根：e(出)+numer(数字)+ate → 按数字一个个点出来 → 列举，枚举

envision.en: to imagine as a future possibility; to visualize
envision.ex_en: We envision Voca as a lifelong companion for independent language learners.
envision.ex_cn: 我们将 Voca 设想为自主语言学习者的终身伴侣。
envision.tip: 词根：en(进入)+vision(视界/愿景) → 在脑海中描绘愿景 → 展望，设想

ephemeral.en: lasting for a very short time
ephemeral.ex_en: Without Ebbinghaus review, cramming before an exam produces only ephemeral memory.
ephemeral.ex_cn: 如果没有艾宾浩斯式的复习，考前突击只能产生转瞬即逝的短暂记忆。
ephemeral.tip: 词根：epi(在…期间)+hemer(一天)+al → 只活一天的 → 转瞬即逝的

equilibrium.en: a state in which opposing forces or influences are balanced
equilibrium.ex_en: An effective study plan maintains an equilibrium between new words and review tasks.
equilibrium.ex_cn: 高效的学习计划在新学词汇与复习任务之间保持均衡。
equilibrium.tip: 词根：equi(相等)+libr(天平/重量)+ium → 天平两端重量相等 → 平衡，均衡

equivalent.en: equal in value, amount, function, meaning, etc.
equivalent.ex_en: Not every English word has a single exact one-to-one equivalent in Chinese.
equivalent.ex_cn: 并非每个英语单词在汉语中都有唯一完全对应的词。
equivalent.tip: 词根：equi(相等)+val(价值)+ent → 价值完全相等的 → 等价的；对应词

eradicate.en: to destroy completely; to put an end to
eradicate.ex_en: Repeated spelling challenges help eradicate stubborn spelling mistakes.
eradicate.ex_cn: 反复的拼写挑战有助于根除顽固的拼写错误。
eradicate.tip: 词根：e(出)+radic(根)+ate → 连根拔起 → 根除，杜绝

erroneous.en: wrong; incorrect; based on mistaken belief
erroneous.ex_en: The system immediately highlights erroneous letters in red during spelling mode.
erroneous.ex_cn: 在拼词模式中，系统会立即用红色高亮显示错误的字母。
erroneous.tip: 词根：err(错误)+oneous → 犯错的 → 错误的，不正确的

escalate.en: to increase rapidly; to become or cause to become more intense or serious
escalate.ex_en: If you skip three days of review, your backlog of unreviewed lists will quickly escalate.
escalate.ex_cn: 如果你跳过三天的复习，积压的未复习词表就会迅速增加。
escalate.tip: 助记：来自 escalator（自动扶梯）→ 像坐扶梯一样层层升高 → 升级，加剧

essential.ex_en: Local data persistence is essential for a truly offline vocabulary application.
essential.ex_cn: 本地数据持久化对于真正离线的背单词应用来说是必不可少的。
essential.tip: 词根：ess(存在/本质)+ent+ial → 构成事物本质的 → 本质的，必不可少的

establish.en: to set up on a firm or permanent basis; to show something to be true or certain
establish.ex_en: First, establish a realistic daily target that fits your schedule.
establish.ex_cn: 首先，确立一个切合你日程安排的每日目标。
establish.tip: 词根：e+stabl(稳定)+ish → 使稳固地立起来 → 建立，证实

evaluate.en: to form an idea of the amount, number, or value of; to assess
evaluate.ex_en: Self-testing in single-language mode lets you honestly evaluate your familiarity.
evaluate.ex_cn: 在单语模式下自测能让你诚实地评估自己对单词的熟悉程度。
evaluate.tip: 词根：e(出)+valu(价值)+ate → 评定出某物的价值 → 评估，评价

evoke.en: to bring or recall a feeling, memory, or image to the conscious mind
evoke.ex_en: Hearing a word pronounced in a natural sentence helps evoke its meaning instantly.
evoke.ex_cn: 在自然例句中听到单词发音有助于瞬间唤起它的词义。
evoke.tip: 词根：e(出)+vok(喊/呼唤)+e → 把内心深处的记忆呼唤出来 → 唤起，勾起

exacerbate.en: to make a problem, bad situation, or negative feeling worse
exacerbate.ex_en: Rote memorization without context only exacerbates learner boredom and fatigue.
exacerbate.ex_cn: 脱离语境的死记硬背只会加剧学习者的枯燥与疲惫感。
exacerbate.tip: 词根：ex(加强)+acerb(酸苦/尖刻)+ate → 使情况变得更苦涩 → 使恶化，加剧

exaggerate.en: to represent something as being larger, better, or worse than it really is
exaggerate.ex_en: It is impossible to exaggerate the importance of vocabulary in academic reading.
exaggerate.ex_cn: 在学术阅读中，词汇的重要性无论怎样强调都不为过。
exaggerate.tip: 词根：ex(出)+agger(堆积)+ate → 堆得高出实际 → 夸大，夸张

exceed.en: to be greater in number or size than a quantity, number, or other measurable thing
exceed.ex_en: When a single file exceeds the 10 MB transfer limit, alternative local synthesis is required.
exceed.ex_cn: 当单个文件超出10MB传输上限时，需要采用替代的本地构建方案。
exceed.tip: 词根：ex(出)+ceed(走) → 走出界限之外 → 超过，超出

exception.en: a person or thing that is excluded from a general statement or does not follow a rule
exception.ex_en: Every rule in English grammar seems to have at least one interesting exception.
exception.ex_cn: 英语语法中的每一条规则似乎都至少有一个有趣的例外。
exception.tip: 词根：ex(出)+cept(拿)+ion → 单独拿出来不按常理算的 → 例外

exemplify.en: to be a typical example of; to give an example of; to illustrate by giving examples
exemplify.ex_en: Well-chosen sentences exemplify how a word functions in real communication.
exemplify.ex_cn: 精选的例句能够举例说明单词在真实交流中是如何运用的。
exemplify.tip: 词根：exempl(榜样/例子)+ify(使…) → 用例子加以说明；成为典范

exhaust.en: to drain of strength or energy; to use up completely; to explore a subject thoroughly
exhaust.ex_en: Short, focused 15-minute study sessions prevent you from exhausting your attention span.
exhaust.ex_cn: 简短专注的15分钟学习单元能防止你耗尽注意力。
exhaust.tip: 考研熟词僻义：exhaust all possibilities 意为“穷尽/详尽探讨所有可能性”

explicit.en: stated clearly and in detail, leaving no room for confusion or doubt
explicit.ex_en: Our test report makes an explicit distinction between verified facts and inferences.
explicit.ex_cn: 我们的测试报告在已验证事实与合理推断之间做出了明确的区分。
explicit.tip: 词根：ex(出)+plic(折叠)+it → 把折叠的东西完全展开 → 明确的（反义：implicit 隐含的）

exploit.en: to make full use of and derive benefit from a resource; to use unfairly
exploit.ex_en: Voca exploits the spacing effect of human memory to maximize learning efficiency.
exploit.ex_cn: Voca 充分利用人类记忆的间隔效应，将学习效率最大化。
exploit.tip: 考研高频词：中性义为“开发、充分利用（资源/机制）”，贬义为“剥削”

facilitate.en: to make an action or process easy or easier
facilitate.ex_en: Keyboard shortcuts on Windows facilitate rapid navigation through word lists.
facilitate.ex_cn: Windows端的键盘快捷键为快速浏览单词列表提供了极大便利。
facilitate.tip: 词根：facil(容易)+itate → 使事情变得容易 → 促进，使便利

feasible.en: possible to do easily or conveniently; likely or probable
feasible.ex_en: Dividing 3,000 words into 15 manageable lists makes the 30-day goal completely feasible.
feasible.ex_cn: 将3000词划分为15个易于管理的词表，使30天攻克目标完全可行。
feasible.tip: 词根：feas(做)+ible → 能够做得到的 → 可行的

fluctuate.en: to rise and fall irregularly in number or amount
fluctuate.ex_en: Even when your daily free time fluctuates, you can adjust the list size flexibly.
fluctuate.ex_cn: 即使你每天的空闲时间有所波动，你也可以灵活调整词表大小。
fluctuate.tip: 词根：fluct(波浪/流动)+uate → 像海浪一样上下起伏 → 波动，涨落

formulate.en: to create or prepare methodically; to express an idea in a concise or systematic way
formulate.ex_en: Before writing any code, we formulate a comprehensive architectural plan.
formulate.ex_cn: 在编写任何代码之前，我们先制定一份周密的技术架构方案。
formulate.tip: 词根：formul(公式/规则)+ate → 形成系统的规则或方案 → 制定，确切表达

foster.en: to encourage or promote the development of something; to bring up a child
foster.ex_en: Immediate visual and audio feedback helps foster a lasting daily study habit.
foster.ex_cn: 即时的视觉和音效反馈有助于培养持久的每日学习习惯。
foster.tip: 助记：与 food（食物）同源 → 给食物喂养长大 → 养育；培养，促进

fundamental.en: forming a necessary base or core; of central importance
fundamental.ex_en: Offline independence is a fundamental design requirement of the Voca project.
fundamental.ex_cn: 离线独立运行是 Voca 项目的一项根本设计要求。
fundamental.tip: 词根：fund(底部/基础)+ament+al → 作为地基的 → 根本的，基础的

genuine.en: truly what something is said to be; authentic; sincere
genuine.ex_en: Deliverables must be genuine executable packages rather than static mockups.
genuine.ex_cn: 交付物必须是真正可运行的程序包，而非静态界面原型。
genuine.tip: 词根：genu(出生/血统)+ine → 血统纯正的 → 真正的，真诚的

hamper.en: to hinder or impede the movement or progress of
hamper.ex_en: Cluttered interfaces and slow startup times hamper learning efficiency.
hamper.ex_cn: 杂乱的界面和缓慢的启动速度会妨碍学习效率。
hamper.tip: 考研高频词：常与 hinder / impede 同义替换，意为“阻碍、牵制”

harness.en: to control and make use of natural resources or power to produce energy or achieve a result
harness.ex_en: Voca harnesses the Ebbinghaus forgetting curve to schedule optimal review intervals.
harness.ex_cn: Voca 利用艾宾浩斯遗忘曲线来规划最佳的复习间隔。
harness.tip: 助记：原指给骏马套上马具使其拉车，引申为“驾驭、有效利用（力量/规律）”

hierarchy.en: a system or organization in which people or groups are ranked one above the other
hierarchy.ex_en: Clear typographic hierarchy separates the headword, phonetics, definitions, and examples.
hierarchy.ex_cn: 清晰的排版层级将单词词目、音标、释义和例句分离开来。
hierarchy.tip: 词根：hier(神圣/高级)+arch(统治)+y → 层层管辖的体系 → 层级结构，等级体系

holistic.en: characterized by comprehension of the parts of something as intimately interconnected
holistic.ex_en: Combining listening, reading, and spelling provides a holistic approach to word mastery.
holistic.ex_cn: 将听音、认读与拼写相结合，提供了一种掌握词汇的整体方法。
holistic.tip: 助记：与 whole（整体）同源 → 从全局和整体看待事物的 → 整体的

hypothesis.en: a supposition or proposed explanation made on the basis of limited evidence as a starting point for further investigation
hypothesis.ex_en: Scientists formulate a testable hypothesis before conducting controlled experiments.
hypothesis.ex_cn: 科学家在进行对照实验之前会提出一个可检验的假说。
hypothesis.tip: 词根：hypo(在…下面)+thesis(放置/论点) → 放在底下作为起点的前提 → 假说，假设

illuminate.en: to light up; to help to clarify or explain a subject or matter
illuminate.ex_en: Etymological notes illuminate the hidden connections between seemingly unrelated words.
illuminate.ex_cn: 词源注释阐明了看似无关的单词之间隐藏的内在联系。
illuminate.tip: 词根：il(进入)+lumin(光)+ate → 把光投射进去 → 照亮；阐明，启发

immerse.en: to dip or submerge in a liquid; to involve oneself deeply in a particular activity
immerse.ex_en: Card mode allows you to immerse yourself in one word at a time without distraction.
immerse.ex_cn: 卡片模式让你可以毫无干扰地一次沉浸于一个单词的学习中。
immerse.tip: 常考搭配：immerse oneself in... / be immersed in...（沉浸于…，全神贯注于…）

imperative.en: of vital importance; crucial; giving an authoritative command
imperative.ex_en: Protecting user data across software updates is an absolute imperative.
imperative.ex_cn: 在软件升级过程中保护用户数据完整是绝对的当务之急。
imperative.tip: 词根：im+per(命令/帝王)+ative → 如同皇命般必须执行的 → 势在必行的；祈使语气

implement.en: to put a decision, plan, agreement, or system into effect; a tool or utensil
implement.ex_en: We implemented a dual-layer persistence engine using LocalStorage and IndexedDB.
implement.ex_cn: 我们使用 LocalStorage 和 IndexedDB 实现了双层持久化存储引擎。
implement.tip: 考研高频词：作动词为“实施、实现”，作名词为“工具、器具”

implicit.en: suggested though not directly expressed; always to be found in; essentially connected with
implicit.ex_en: Understanding implicit cultural connotations requires reading authentic examples.
implicit.ex_cn: 理解隐含的文化内涵需要阅读地道的例句。
implicit.tip: 词根：im(进入)+plic(折叠)+it → 折在里面没露出来的 → 隐含的（反义：explicit 明确的）

incentive.en: a thing that motivates or encourages one to do something
incentive.ex_en: Tracking your daily streak and watching the unfamiliar list shrink provides a strong incentive.
incentive.ex_cn: 追踪每日连胜天数并看着生词列表不断缩小，能提供强大的学习动力。
incentive.tip: 词根：in(进入)+cent(唱歌)+ive → 奏起战歌鼓舞士气 → 激励，诱因

incorporate.en: to take in or contain something as part of a whole; to include
incorporate.ex_en: Voca incorporates the best design ideas from minimalist cards and Ebbinghaus planners.
incorporate.ex_cn: Voca 融合吸收了极简卡片与艾宾浩斯规划表的精华设计理念。
incorporate.tip: 词根：in(进入)+corpor(身体/整体)+ate → 并入同一个整体 → 纳入，包含

indispensable.ex_en: An accurate phonetic guide is an indispensable tool for self-taught learners.
indispensable.ex_cn: 准确的音标指南是自学者不可或缺的工具。
indispensable.tip: 词根：in(不)+dispens(免除/省掉)+able → 绝不能省掉的 → 不可或缺的

inevitable.ex_en: Forgetting is an inevitable biological process unless countered by spaced review.
inevitable.ex_cn: 遗忘是不可避免的生理过程，除非通过间隔复习加以对抗。
inevitable.tip: 词根：in(不)+evit(避免)+able → 无法避免的 → 必然的

infer.en: to deduce or conclude information from evidence and reasoning rather than from explicit statements
infer.ex_en: Never infer unverified functionality without inspecting the actual artifact or documentation.
infer.ex_cn: 在未检查实际文件或文档之前，切勿凭空推断未经证实的功能。
infer.tip: 词根：in(进入)+fer(带来) → 从已知事实带出结论 → 推断，推论

inherent.en: existing in something as a permanent, essential, or characteristic attribute
inherent.ex_en: Platform sandboxing has inherent constraints that must be documented transparently.
inherent.ex_cn: 平台沙箱具有固有的环境限制，必须透明如实地加以说明。
inherent.tip: 词根：in(在里面)+her(粘附)+ent → 本身就粘附在里面的 → 固有的，内在的（常接 in）

inhibit.en: to hinder, restrain, or prevent an action or process
inhibit.ex_en: Fear of making mistakes can inhibit learners from practicing spoken English.
inhibit.ex_cn: 害怕犯错可能会抑制学习者练习英语口语的积极性。
inhibit.tip: 词根：in(里)+hibit(拿住/按住) → 按住不让动 → 抑制，阻止

initiate.en: to cause a process or action to begin
initiate.ex_en: Click 'Start Today's Plan' to initiate your scheduled Ebbinghaus learning session.
initiate.ex_cn: 点击“开始今日计划”即可启动你今日规划的艾宾浩斯学习单元。
initiate.tip: 词根：in(进入)+it(走)+iate → 迈出第一步 → 开始，发起

innovative.en: featuring new methods; advanced and original
innovative.ex_en: The five-card letter selector provides an innovative tactile way to practice spelling.
innovative.ex_cn: 五卡片字母点选器为练习单词拼写提供了一种新颖的触控交互方式。
innovative.tip: 词根：in(内)+nov(新)+ative → 由内而外推陈出新的 → 创新的

integrity.en: the quality of being honest and having strong moral principles; the state of being whole and undivided
integrity.ex_en: Before exporting backups, the system verifies the structural integrity of all user records.
integrity.ex_cn: 在导出备份之前，系统会校验所有用户记录的结构完整性。
integrity.tip: 考研高频双义词：既指人的品格“正直、诚信”，也指数据/系统的“完整性、健全”

intelligible.ex_en: Technical architecture guides should be written in clear, intelligible prose.
intelligible.ex_cn: 技术架构指南应当用清晰易懂的语言编写。
intelligible.tip: 词根：intel(在…之间)+lig(选择/读)+ible → 能够读懂理解的 → 清晰易懂的

intricate.ex_en: An intricate network of synonyms and roots links thousands of English words together.
intricate.ex_cn: 错综复杂的同义词与词根网络将成千上万个英语单词联系在一起。
intricate.tip: 词根：in(进入)+tric(障碍/纠缠)+ate → 缠绕在一起的 → 错综复杂的，精细的

intrinsic.ex_en: Curiosity and the joy of mastery provide intrinsic motivation for lifelong learning.
intrinsic.ex_cn: 好奇心与掌握知识的喜悦为终身学习提供了内在动力。
intrinsic.tip: 常考对比：intrinsic value（内在价值）vs extrinsic reward（外在奖励）

intuitive.en: using or based on what one feels to be true even without conscious reasoning; easy to understand or operate without explicit instruction
intuitive.ex_en: Swipe gestures and keyboard shortcuts make Voca's interface immediately intuitive.
intuitive.ex_cn: 滑动手势与键盘快捷键使 Voca 的界面直观易用。
intuitive.tip: 词根：in(向内)+tuit(看/守护)+ive → 内心一眼看穿的 → 直觉的；直观易用的

jeopardize.en: to put someone or something into a situation in which there is a danger of loss, harm, or failure
jeopardize.ex_en: Using unauthorized commercial dictionary data would jeopardize legal compliance.
jeopardize.ex_cn: 使用未经授权的商业词典数据会危及项目的法律合规性。
jeopardize.tip: 词根：jeopard(危险)+ize → 使陷入危险 → 危及，损害

legitimate.en: conforming to the law or to rules; able to be defended with logic or justification
legitimate.ex_en: All built-in lexicons are compiled from legitimate open-source and public-syllabus sources.
legitimate.ex_cn: 所有内置词库均汇编自合法合规的开源词库与公共考纲资源。
legitimate.tip: 词根：leg(法律)+itim+ate → 符合法律与事理的 → 合法的，正当合理的

lucid.en: expressed clearly; easy to understand; showing ability to think clearly
lucid.ex_en: Each word entry includes a lucid English definition alongside concise Chinese meanings.
lucid.ex_cn: 每个词条都包含清晰易懂的英文释义以及简明的中文释义。
lucid.tip: 词根：luc(光)+id → 透亮的 → 清晰易懂的，清醒的

manifest.en: to display or show a quality or feeling by one's acts or appearance; clear or obvious to the eye or mind
manifest.ex_en: The benefits of the 1-2-4-7-15 review cycle manifest clearly during final exam preparation.
manifest.ex_cn: 1-2-4-7-15复习周期的益处在期末备考阶段会清晰地显现出来。
manifest.tip: 词根：mani(手)+fest(打击/抓到) → 当场抓在手里无可抵赖 → 明显的；表明

manipulate.en: to handle or control a tool, mechanism, or information in a skillful manner; to control unfairly
manipulate.ex_en: Users can freely manipulate list counts, ordering modes, and export filters.
manipulate.ex_cn: 用户可以自由操作调整词表数量、排序方式和导出筛选条件。
manipulate.tip: 词根：mani(手)+pul(满)+ate → 用双手熟练摆弄 → 熟练操作；操纵

meticulous.en: showing great attention to detail; very careful and precise
meticulous.ex_en: Meticulous verification of every binary header ensures cross-platform compatibility.
meticulous.ex_cn: 对每一个二进制文件头的一丝不苟的校验确保了跨平台兼容性。
meticulous.tip: 词根：met(害怕)+icul+ous → 唯恐出一点差错的 → 一丝不苟的，严谨细致的

mitigate.en: to make less severe, serious, or painful
mitigate.ex_en: Warm paper and dark themes help mitigate visual fatigue during long study sessions.
mitigate.ex_cn: 羊皮纸主题与暗夜主题有助于缓解长时间学习时的视觉疲劳。
mitigate.tip: 词根：miti(温和)+gate(做) → 使变得缓和 → 减轻，缓解

paradigm.en: a typical example or pattern of something; a model or philosophical framework
paradigm.ex_en: Active recall combined with spaced repetition represents a proven learning paradigm.
paradigm.ex_cn: 主动回忆结合间隔重复代表了一种经过验证的科学学习范式。
paradigm.tip: 词根：para(在旁边)+digm(展示) → 摆在旁边供人参照的样本 → 范式，典范

perceive.en: to become aware or conscious of something; to come to realize or understand
perceive.ex_en: Learners quickly perceive a boost in reading speed after mastering core high-frequency words.
perceive.ex_cn: 在掌握核心高频词后，学习者很快就能察觉到阅读速度的提升。
perceive.tip: 词根：per(完全)+ceiv(抓/拿) → 通过感官完全捕捉到 → 感知，认为

perpetual.en: never ending or changing; occurring repeatedly; so frequent as to seem endless
perpetual.ex_en: Without marking mastered words, learners often feel trapped in a perpetual loop of easy words.
perpetual.ex_cn: 如果不剔除已掌握的熟词，学习者往往会感觉被困在简单词的无尽循环中。
perpetual.tip: 词根：per(从头到尾)+pet(追求/走)+ual → 一直走到底永不停息 → 永久的，不断的

persevere.en: to continue in a course of action even in the face of difficulty or with little or no prospect of success
persevere.ex_en: If you persevere through the 30-day Ebbinghaus matrix, every list will be reviewed five times.
persevere.ex_cn: 如果你坚持走完30天的艾宾浩斯矩阵，每个词表都将得到五轮扎实复习。
persevere.tip: 词根：per(自始至终)+severe(严格/严肃) → 自始至终严格要求自己 → 坚持不懈

pertinent.en: relevant or applicable to a particular matter; apposite
pertinent.ex_en: Each example sentence is concise and pertinent to the word's primary exam meaning.
pertinent.ex_cn: 每个例句都简明扼要，且切合该单词在考试中的核心词义。
pertinent.tip: 词根：per(加强)+tin(握住/保持)+ent → 紧紧扣住主题的 → 相关的，切题的

plausible.en: seeming reasonable or probable; appearing worthy of belief
plausible.ex_en: In multiple-choice tests, distractors are designed to look plausible at first glance.
plausible.ex_cn: 在选择题测试中，干扰项被设计得咋一看貌似合理。
plausible.tip: 词根：plaus(鼓掌)+ible → 值得鼓掌叫好的、听起来很有道理的 → 貌似可信的

pragmatic.en: dealing with things sensibly and realistically in a way that is based on practical rather than theoretical considerations
pragmatic.ex_en: Our architecture takes a pragmatic approach to ensure reliable offline execution.
pragmatic.ex_cn: 我们的架构采取务实的设计方案，以确保可靠的离线运行。
pragmatic.tip: 考研核心词：常与 idealistic（理想主义的）或 theoretical（理论的）相对，意为“务实的”

precede.en: to come before something in time, order, or position
precede.ex_en: Thorough requirement analysis must always precede software implementation.
precede.ex_cn: 周密的需求分析必须始终先于软件编码实现。
precede.tip: 词根：pre(在前)+ced(走)+e → 走在前面 → 先于（注意区分 proceed 继续进行）

precipitate.en: to cause an event or situation to happen suddenly, unexpectedly, or prematurely
precipitate.ex_en: Rushing into coding without a clear plan can precipitate costly architectural rework.
precipitate.ex_cn: 没有清晰规划就仓促编码可能会招致代价高昂的架构返工。
precipitate.tip: 词根：pre(前)+cipit(头)+ate → 头朝下猛栽下去 → 加速促成；鲁莽的；沉淀

preclude.en: to prevent from happening; to make impossible
preclude.ex_en: Strict sandbox isolation precludes direct outbound network downloads during runtime.
preclude.ex_cn: 严格的沙箱隔离排除了在运行期间直接向外网下载文件的可能性。
preclude.tip: 词根：pre(提前)+clud(关闭)+e → 提前把门关死 → 排除，使不可能

predominant.en: present as the strongest or main element; having or exerting control or power
predominant.ex_en: Emerald green is the predominant brand accent color in Voca's visual identity.
predominant.ex_cn: 翠绿色是 Voca 视觉识别体系中占主导地位的品牌强调色。
predominant.tip: 词根：pre(在前)+domin(统治)+ant → 占据最显著主导地位的 → 主导的，最主要的

prerequisite.en: a thing that is required as a prior condition for something else to happen or exist
prerequisite.ex_en: A solid foundation of 5,000 core words is a prerequisite for fluent academic reading.
prerequisite.ex_cn: 五千核心词汇的扎实基础是流利进行学术阅读的先决条件。
prerequisite.tip: 词根：pre(预先)+requisit(要求/需要)+e → 预先需要具备的条件 → 先决条件

pristine.en: in its original condition; unspoiled; clean and fresh as if new
pristine.ex_en: Restoring a word from the vocabulary book reverts its definition to the pristine dictionary text.
pristine.ex_cn: 将单词从生词本移除会将其释义恢复为词库原始的纯净文本。
pristine.tip: 词根：prist(最初的)+ine → 保持最初完美状态的 → 一尘不染的，原始未受损的

proficient.en: competent or skilled in doing or using something
proficient.ex_en: With systematic daily practice, you will soon become proficient in recognizing academic vocabulary.
proficient.ex_cn: 通过系统的每日练习，你很快就能熟练识别学术词汇。
proficient.tip: 常考搭配：be proficient in / at...（精通于…，熟练掌握…）

profound.en: very great or intense; having or showing great knowledge or insight
profound.ex_en: Ebbinghaus's discovery had a profound impact on modern educational psychology.
profound.ex_cn: 艾宾浩斯的发现对现代教育心理学产生了深远的影响。
profound.tip: 词根：pro(向前/到底)+found(底部) → 直达最深处的 → 深刻的，深远的

proliferate.en: to increase rapidly in numbers; to multiply
proliferate.ex_en: Mobile learning apps have proliferated over the past decade, yet few work truly offline.
proliferate.ex_cn: 过去十年间移动学习应用大量涌现，但真正能纯粹离线运行的却寥寥无几。
proliferate.tip: 词根：proli(后代)+fer(产生)+ate → 繁衍出大量后代 → 激增，迅速涌现

prominent.en: important; famous; projecting from something; protuberant
prominent.ex_en: The language mode switcher is placed in a prominent position on the main toolbar.
prominent.ex_cn: 中英模式切换按钮被放置在主工具栏的显眼位置上。
prominent.tip: 词根：pro(向前)+min(伸出/突出)+ent → 向前凸出来的 → 突出的，显眼的，杰出的

propagate.en: to spread and promote an idea, theory, etc. widely; to breed specimens of a plant or animal
propagate.ex_en: Edits made to a word inside the starred notebook automatically propagate to the main lexicon view.
propagate.ex_cn: 在生词本中对单词释义所做的修改会自动同步传递到主词库视图中。
propagate.tip: 词根：pro(向前)+pag(插条/固定)+ate → 把枝条插下去繁衍传开 → 传播，繁殖

reciprocate.en: to respond to a gesture or action by making a corresponding one
reciprocate.ex_en: Your brain will reciprocate your consistent study effort with effortless reading comprehension.
reciprocate.ex_cn: 你的大脑将以轻松自如的阅读理解力来回报你持之以恒的学习付出。
reciprocate.tip: 词根：re(向后)+ciproc(向后)+ate → 有来有往 → 回报，互惠

reconcile.en: to restore friendly relations between; to make one account consistent with another
reconcile.ex_en: Voca is designed to reconcile minimalist aesthetics with high-density study efficiency.
reconcile.ex_cn: Voca 旨在将极简主义美学与高密度的学习效率融洽统一起来。
reconcile.tip: 考研高频词：reconcile A with B（使A与B调和一致/调解矛盾）

redundant.en: not or no longer needed or useful; superfluous
redundant.ex_en: Marking known words as mastered eliminates redundant repetition of vocabulary you already know.
redundant.ex_cn: 将认识的词标记为熟词，可以消除对已知词汇的多余重复。
redundant.tip: 词根：red(反复)+und(波浪)+ant → 波浪一层又一层涌来过多 → 多余的，冗余的

refute.en: to prove a statement or theory to be wrong or false; to disprove
refute.ex_en: Solid experimental evidence was presented to refute the outdated assumption.
refute.ex_cn: 展示了确凿的实验证据来驳斥那个过时的假设。
refute.tip: 词根：re(反)+fut(打击)+e → 反击对方的谬论 → 驳斥，证明…有误

reinforce.en: to strengthen or support, especially with additional personnel or material
reinforce.ex_en: Each review stage on Days 1, 2, 4, 7, and 15 serves to reinforce neural pathways.
reinforce.ex_cn: 第1、2、4、7、15天的每个复习阶段都起到了强化神经通路的作用。
reinforce.tip: 词根：re(再次)+in(进入)+force(力量) → 再次注入强大的力量 → 强化，加固

relinquish.en: to voluntarily cease to keep or claim; to give up
relinquish.ex_en: Offline storage ensures that users never relinquish ownership of their personal study records.
relinquish.ex_cn: 离线存储确保用户永远不会失去对个人学习记录的所有权。
relinquish.tip: 词根：re(向后)+linqu(离开/留)+ish → 放手留给别人 → 放弃，交出

resilient.en: able to withstand or recover quickly from difficult conditions
resilient.ex_en: A resilient storage engine recovers gracefully even after an unexpected power loss.
resilient.ex_cn: 具有韧性的存储引擎即使在意外断电后也能完好地恢复数据。
resilient.tip: 词根：re(回)+sil(跳)+ient → 被压下去还能弹回来的 → 有韧性的，迅速恢复的

retain.en: to continue to have something; to keep possession of; to absorb and continue to hold
retain.ex_en: Learners retain up to 90% of vocabulary when following the five-stage Ebbinghaus schedule.
retain.ex_cn: 遵循五阶段艾宾浩斯复习计划时，学习者能记住高达90%的词汇。
retain.tip: 词根：re(回)+tain(拿住) → 牢牢拿在手里不丢 → 保持，记住

retrieve.en: to get or bring something back; to find and extract stored data
retrieve.ex_en: You can instantly retrieve any accidentally deleted word from the Mastered Words drawer.
retrieve.ex_cn: 你可以随时从“熟词表”抽屉中立即找回任何误删的单词。
retrieve.tip: 词根：re(重新)+triev(找到)+e → 重新找回来 → 找回，检索

rigorous.en: extremely thorough, exhaustive, or accurate; strictly applied or adhered to
rigorous.ex_en: All core functions underwent rigorous verification before packaging the final release.
rigorous.ex_cn: 所有核心功能在打包最终发布版之前都经过了严密的验证。
rigorous.tip: 词根：rigor(严格/僵硬)+ous → 一丝不苟毫不松懈的 → 严密的，严格的

scrutinize.en: to examine or inspect closely and thoroughly
scrutinize.ex_en: We scrutinized the IPA package metadata and official specifications before designing Voca.
scrutinize.ex_cn: 在设计 Voca 之前，我们仔细审视了 IPA 包元数据与官方技术规格。
scrutinize.tip: 词根：scrutin(翻找检查)+ize → 翻个底朝天仔细查 → 仔细检查，详审

simultaneous.en: occurring, operating, or done at the same time
simultaneous.ex_en: Bilingual mode provides simultaneous visibility of both the English word and its Chinese meaning.
simultaneous.ex_cn: 双语模式让你能够同时看到英语单词及其汉语释义。
simultaneous.tip: 词根：simul(同时/相似)+taneous → 在同一时刻发生的 → 同时的，同步的

spontaneous.en: performed or occurring as a result of a sudden inner impulse or inclination and without premeditation
spontaneous.ex_en: True fluency means spontaneous comprehension without translating word by word.
spontaneous.ex_cn: 真正的流利意味着自发的理解，而无需逐词翻译。
spontaneous.tip: 词根：spont(自愿/心意)+aneous → 发自本心自然流露的 → 自发的，自然的

subsequent.en: coming after something in time; following
subsequent.ex_en: Day 1 is for initial memorization, while subsequent days focus on spaced reinforcement.
subsequent.ex_cn: 第一天用于初次记忆，而随后的几天则侧重于间隔强化。
subsequent.tip: 词根：sub(在后面)+sequ(跟随)+ent → 紧跟在后面的 → 随后的，后来的

substantiate.en: to provide evidence to support or prove the truth of
substantiate.ex_en: Every claim in the test report must be substantiated by actual execution checks.
substantiate.ex_cn: 测试报告中的每一项声明都必须有实际的运行检查结果予以证实。
substantiate.tip: 词根：substant(实质/实体)+iate → 拿出实质证据支撑 → 证实，证明

subtle.en: so delicate or precise as to be difficult to analyze or describe; making use of clever and indirect methods
subtle.ex_en: Subtle card animations provide tactile feedback without distracting the learner.
subtle.ex_cn: 微妙细腻的卡片动效提供了触感反馈，同时不会分散学习者的注意力。
subtle.tip: 发音与拼写重点：字母 b 不发音（/ˈsʌtl/），常考形容词义“微妙的、不易察觉的”

succinct.ex_en: Dictionary definitions should be succinct so learners can grasp the core meaning at a glance.
succinct.ex_cn: 词典释义应当简明扼要，以便学习者一眼掌握核心词义。
succinct.tip: 词根：suc(在下面)+cinct(束紧衣带) → 把长袍扎紧利落 → 简明的，言简意赅的

sustain.en: to strengthen or support physically or mentally; to cause to continue for an extended period
sustain.ex_en: Visual progress rings help sustain learner engagement across the full 30-day cycle.
sustain.ex_cn: 可视化的进度环有助于在整个30天周期内持续维持学习者的投入度。
sustain.tip: 词根：sus(在下面)+tain(握住/撑住) → 在底下牢牢托住 → 维持，支撑

synthesize.en: to combine a number of things into a coherent whole; to produce by chemical or electronic synthesis
synthesize.ex_en: The audio engine can synthesize clear tones and speech completely offline.
synthesize.ex_cn: 音频引擎能够在完全离线的状态下合成清晰的提示音与语音。
synthesize.tip: 词根：syn(共同)+thes(放置)+ize → 放到一起融合成整体 → 综合，合成

tangible.en: perceptible by touch; clear and definite; real
tangible.ex_en: Watching your mastered word count climb gives you a tangible sense of achievement.
tangible.ex_cn: 看着已掌握的熟词数量不断攀升，会给你带来切实的成就感。
tangible.tip: 词根：tang(接触/触摸)+ible → 摸得着的 → 有形的，切实的（反义：intangible 无形的）

tentative.en: not certain or fixed; provisional; done without confidence
tentative.ex_en: Inferences without binary confirmation must be labeled as tentative rather than verified facts.
tentative.ex_cn: 未经二进制确认的推断必须标明为试探性推断，而非已验证事实。
tentative.tip: 词根：tent(尝试/试探)+ative → 试探着来的 → 暂定的，试探性的

threshold.en: a strip of wood or stone forming the bottom of a doorway; the magnitude or intensity that must be exceeded for a certain reaction
threshold.ex_en: Once a word's unfamiliarity score crosses a threshold, it is prioritized for extra spelling practice.
threshold.ex_cn: 一旦单词的“不会程度”超过设定阈值，系统就会优先安排其进行额外的拼写强化。
threshold.tip: 助记：thresh(打谷)+hold(保持) → 门口挡住谷粒的木板 → 门槛，临界值

transcend.en: to be or go beyond the range or limits of something abstract; to surpass
transcend.ex_en: Good software design transcends platform boundaries while respecting native ergonomics.
transcend.ex_cn: 优秀的软件设计在尊重各平台原生操作习惯的同时，超越了平台界限。
transcend.tip: 词根：trans(跨越)+scend(攀爬) → 翻越过去 → 超越，胜过

transient.en: lasting only for a short time; impermanent
transient.ex_en: Sensory memory is transient and fades within seconds unless transferred to long-term storage.
transient.ex_cn: 感觉记忆是短暂的，除非转化为长期存储，否则在几秒钟内就会消退。
transient.tip: 词根：trans(越过)+i(走)+ent → 匆匆走过不停留的 → 短暂的，转瞬即逝的

transparent.en: allowing light to pass through so that objects behind can be distinctly seen; open to public scrutiny
transparent.ex_en: Our documentation provides a transparent account of all data sources and licenses.
transparent.ex_cn: 我们的文档对所有数据来源及开源授权依据提供了公开透明的说明。
transparent.tip: 词根：trans(穿过)+par(显现)+ent → 光线能穿透显现的 → 透明的，坦率的

ubiquitous.ex_en: Smartphones and laptops have made digital learning tools ubiquitous in modern education.
ubiquitous.ex_cn: 智能手机和笔记本电脑使数字化学习工具在现代教育中无处不在。
ubiquitous.tip: 词根：ubi(何处/处处)+quit+ous → 到处都有的 → 无处不在的

undermine.en: to erode the base or foundation of; to lessen the effectiveness, power, or ability of, especially gradually or insidiously
undermine.ex_en: Inconsistent study habits will gradually undermine your confidence before the exam.
undermine.ex_cn: 三天打鱼两天晒网的学习习惯会在考前逐渐削弱你的信心。
undermine.tip: 词根：under(在…下面)+mine(挖矿/挖地道) → 在城墙底下挖地道 → 暗中破坏，动摇根基

unprecedented.ex_en: Modern offline storage APIs offer unprecedented reliability for standalone educational apps.
unprecedented.ex_cn: 现代离线存储接口为单机教育应用提供了前所未有的可靠性。
unprecedented.tip: 词根：un(无)+precedent(先例)+ed → 没有先例的 → 史无前例的，空前的

validate.en: to check or prove the validity or accuracy of something; to make or declare legally valid
validate.ex_en: Automated scripts validate the APK signature block and PE32+ executable headers.
validate.ex_cn: 自动化脚本对 APK 签名块和 PE32+ 可执行文件头进行了严格验证。
validate.tip: 词根：valid(有效的)+ate → 证明其有效 → 验证，证实

versatile.en: able to adapt or be adapted to many different functions or activities
versatile.ex_en: Voca is a versatile vocabulary studio supporting card review, dictation, spelling, and PDF printing.
versatile.ex_cn: Voca 是一款多功能词汇学习工坊，支持卡片复习、听写、拼词和打印版导出。
versatile.tip: 词根：vers(转)+atile → 能灵活转向应对各种场景的 → 多功能的，多才多艺的

viable.en: capable of working successfully; feasible; capable of surviving or living successfully
viable.ex_en: Local SQLite and IndexedDB storage provide a viable architecture for zero-network operation.
viable.ex_cn: 本地 SQLite 与 IndexedDB 存储为零网络运行提供了切实可行的架构。
viable.tip: 词根：vi(生命/生活)+able → 能活下去的、行得通的 → 可行的，能存续的

vulnerable.en: exposed to the possibility of being attacked or harmed, either physically or emotionally
vulnerable.ex_en: Newly learned words are highly vulnerable to forgetting during the first twenty-four hours.
vulnerable.ex_cn: 新学到的单词在最初的二十四小时内极易被遗忘。
vulnerable.tip: 词根：vulner(伤口)+able → 容易受伤的 → 脆弱的，易受影响的（常接 to）

the: The old library on campus opens at eight every morning.
校园里的那座老图书馆每天早上八点开放。
be: She wants to be a doctor and help people in small villages.
她想成为一名医生，帮助小村庄里的人们。
and: Tom bought bread and milk at the shop near his home.
汤姆在他家附近的商店买了面包和牛奶。
of: She drank a cup of hot tea before going to bed.
她在睡觉前喝了一杯热茶。
a: He found a small key under the mat by the door.
他在门边的垫子下面找到了一把小钥匙。
in: The children are playing happily in the park this afternoon.
孩子们今天下午在公园里开心地玩耍。
to: We walked to the station early to catch the first train.
我们很早步行去车站，赶第一班火车。
have: They have two dogs and a cat at their country house.
他们在乡下的房子里有两只狗和一只猫。
it: It started to rain heavily just as we left the building.
我们刚离开大楼，天就开始下大雨了。
i: I usually read a book before I go to sleep.
我通常在睡觉前读一本书。
that: That tall building across the river is the new museum.
河对岸那座高楼是新博物馆。
for: She bought a birthday gift for her younger sister yesterday.
她昨天为妹妹买了一份生日礼物。
you: You should drink more water when the weather is hot.
天气热的时候你应该多喝水。
he: He rides his bicycle to work every day except Sunday.
他除了星期天每天都骑自行车上班。
with: She went to the market with her mother this morning.
她今天早上和母亲一起去了市场。
on: Please put the books on the table near the window.
请把书放在窗户旁边的桌子上。
do: What do you usually do on weekends with your friends?
你周末通常和朋友们做什么。
say: He did not say anything during the whole meeting yesterday.
他昨天在整个会议期间什么也没说。
this: This red bag on the chair belongs to my sister.
椅子上这个红色的包是我姐姐的。
they: They moved to a quiet town near the sea last year.
他们去年搬到了海边一个安静的小镇。
at: We will meet at the school gate at seven tomorrow morning.
我们明天早上七点在学校门口见面。
but: The shop is small but it sells many useful things.
这家商店虽小，但卖很多有用的东西。
we: We planted many flowers in the garden last spring together.
去年春天我们一起在花园里种了很多花。
his: His new car is parked outside the office building now.
他的新车现在停在办公楼外面。
from: This letter from my old friend arrived in the mail today.
我老朋友的这封信今天通过邮件寄到了。
